subject: Life Skills
title: Repairing Broken Trust
description: Learn Repairing Broken Trust in one minute.

hook.text: She lied about a missed deadline. He found out. The project survived but the partnership felt hollow for months.

buildup.text: Broken trust triggers the same brain regions as physical pain.

discovery.text: Repair starts with a full acknowledgment: what you did, why it hurt, and what you will change.

twist.text: Words alone cannot rebuild trust. Only changed behavior over time restores it.

climax.text: Repairing Broken Trust matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Apology opens the door. Changed behavior walks through it.

quiz.question: What rebuilds broken trust most effectively?
options: Specific, observable changed behavior sustained over time
Explaining your reasons for the betrayal
